build_running_with_scissors_substrate: build a rock-paper-scissors matrix game substrate with one-shot resource collection and single-interaction episodes
create_resource_prefab: create a resource prefab with a given resource id, shape, and color palette for rock-paper-scissors resource types
create_avatar_object: create an avatar game object with movement, turning, interaction beam, inventory observation, and game interaction zapper components
create_scene: create the global scene with TheMatrix component containing a 3x3 rock-paper-scissors payoff matrix and interaction readiness rules
get_config: get the substrate configuration with action set, observation specs, timestep specs, and player role definitions
